tasks.title: Confirm the current `src/Layout` compile order, public `.fsi` boundaries, test projects, and sample entry points affected by automatic layout.
Add the pinned `Yoga.Net` `3.2.3` package reference to `src/Layout/Layout.fsproj` without exposing Yoga.Net types in public signatures.
Create readiness scaffolding under `specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout/readiness/` for FSI, logs, performance, sample smoke, and surface baselines.
Record Tier 1 evidence obligations, dependency pinning rationale, MVU applicability, and unsupported v1 scope in `specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout/readiness/evidence-obligations.md`.
Draft automatic layout geometry, sizing, visibility, measurement, diagnostics, result, and pixel snapping types in `src/Layout/Types.fsi`.

Draft default constructors and public evaluator functions in `src/Layout/Layout.fsi` or `src/Layout/YogaLayout.fsi`, including `evaluate`, `evaluateIncremental`, `renderComputed`, `snapBounds`, and `hitTestComputed`.
Add matching implementation placeholders and compile-order entries in `src/Layout/Types.fs`, `src/Layout/Layout.fs`, and any new Yoga layout implementation files.
Add semantic test helpers in `tests/Layout.Tests/Tests.fs` for reading computed bounds, asserting non-overlap, deterministic results, diagnostics, and visibility.
Add `scripts/layout-prelude.fsx` coverage for the intended public automatic layout API and expected readiness transcript path.
Add or update package surface baseline generation notes for `FS.Skia.UI.Layout` under `specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout/readiness/surface-baselines/`.
Define validation rules for duplicate node ids, invalid available space, invalid numeric style values, invalid measurement output, min/max conflicts, and v1 rejection of absolute or overlay intent.
Define the Yoga.Net adapter boundary so Yoga nodes are allocated, styled, measured, evaluated, read back, and disposed without leaking Yoga.Net types through `.fsi`.
Define the deterministic fallback geometry policy for recoverable failures, including bounded root and child rectangles plus `LayoutDiagnostic` records.
Define the invalidation model for node intent, visibility, child structure, parent size, and content measurement changes, including stable unchanged sibling bounds.
Build the foundation surface and capture an initial FSI or build transcript proving the public signatures are reachable from the package.
Add semantic tests for row, column, and wrap containers with non-overlapping child bounds inside the parent.
Add semantic tests for parent padding, child margin, row and column gaps, and main/cross-axis alignment.
Add semantic tests for fixed, min, max, flex grow, flex shrink, flex basis, and deterministic repeated evaluation.
Add public API tests for custom content measurement callbacks that return preferred logical sizes and diagnostics.
Implement default automatic layout records and helper constructors for layout intents, nodes, available space, and pixel snap policies.
Implement Yoga.Net style mapping for direction, wrap, alignment, justification, padding, margin, gap, fixed/min/max size, grow, shrink, and basis.
Implement recursive layout tree evaluation through Yoga.Net and read back one logical `ComputedBounds` entry per participating node.
Implement custom leaf measurement callback bridging between public `MeasureRequest` / `MeasureResponse` and Yoga.Net measure callbacks.
Implement deterministic result ordering, finite logical bounds normalization, and valid-layout non-overlap guarantees.
Capture US1 readiness evidence through `dotnet test --filter` or equivalent and the FSI prelude transcript for nested element layout.
Add semantic tests for mixed standard widgets and custom elements participating in one automatic layout tree.
Add resize and incremental evaluation tests proving changed parent size or child measurement updates bounds without stale overlap.
Add invalidation locality tests proving unaffected sibling subtrees keep byte-for-byte equivalent computed bounds after unrelated changes.
Add render and hit-test tests proving computed logical bounds are consumed without independent layout recalculation.
Add fixtures or adapters that let existing element/widget scene content attach to `LayoutNode.Content` while keeping automatic layout opt-in.
Implement `evaluateIncremental` revision handling, invalidated node reporting, and changed-node ancestor propagation.
Implement `renderComputed` so scene content is positioned from computed bounds while existing manual stack, dock, graph, absolute, and overlay composition keep working.
Implement `snapBounds` and `hitTestComputed` with one deterministic `PixelSnapPolicy` shared by rendering and hit testing.
Add or update `samples/LayoutGraphGallery` and `samples/DemoReel` automatic layout examples for nested elements, mixed widgets, resizing, flexible sizing, and hidden elements.
Capture US2 readiness evidence through widget/invalidation tests and sample smoke transcript under `readiness/sample-smoke/`.
Add semantic tests for invalid available space, invalid style values, min/max conflicts, and size requests larger than the parent.
Add semantic tests for unmeasurable content, invalid measurement callback output, hidden nodes, and collapsed nodes.
Add tests proving recoverable failures return structured diagnostics and bounded fallback geometry without terminating render flow.
Implement structured diagnostic creation with node id, code, severity, message, constraint, and fallback flags.
Implement validation and normalization for available space, layout intent values, measurement output, and unsupported automatic-layout scope.
Implement safe fallback bounds for recoverable constraints and propagate diagnostics through `LayoutResult.Diagnostics`.
Implement hidden and collapsed node behavior so visibility diagnostics are distinguishable from layout failures and visible siblings stay stable.
Capture US3 readiness evidence for invalid/conflicting layouts and diagnostic samples.
Refresh `FS.Skia.UI.Layout` surface-area baseline and package tests for the new public contract.
Update `specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout/quickstart.md` and layout interaction docs for final public names, pointer hit testing, keyboard focus regions, visual bounds, and pixel snapping behavior.

Add performance evidence for representative 200-node resize/re-layout under `readiness/performance/yoga-layout-200-node-resize.txt`, including command, hardware/runtime profile, iteration count, median/p95 timing, and pass/fail against the SC-004 threshold.
Run `dotnet restore`, `dotnet build`, and `dotnet test`, saving final logs under `readiness/logs/`.
Run the layout FSI prelude and save `readiness/fsi/yoga-layout-prelude.txt`.
Run automatic layout sample smoke checks and save `readiness/sample-smoke/automatic-layout-gallery.txt`.
Run `.specify/extensions/evidence/scripts/bash/run-audit.sh specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout --graph-only` and confirm no dangling refs, cycles, or unexpected `[S*]` propagation.
Run `.specify/extensions/evidence/scripts/bash/run-audit.sh specs/005-add-yoga-net-layout` and document PASS or every explicit synthetic-evidence override.

Draft the stateful host/sample layout workflow contract for resize, widget updates, and content-measurement invalidation, including `Model`, `Msg`, `Effect` or `Cmd<Msg>`, `init`, `update`, and interpreter boundary.
Add pure transition tests for the host/sample layout workflow covering resize, visibility changes, layout-intent changes, and content-measurement changes.
Add emitted-effect assertions and real interpreter evidence for the host/sample layout workflow where safe, saving transcript output under `readiness/fsi/`.
Document and test keyboard focus region alignment with computed visual bounds and pointer hit-test bounds after pixel snapping.
